home.title: ChartDown App
home.tagline: Number charts for the whole band, with each player’s notes.

warnings.instrument-id: Instrument ids use lowercase letters, digits and -: “{id}”
warnings.no-section: Bars need a section first, like ## Verse 1
warnings.use-not-found: Can’t find an earlier section named “{name}”
warnings.beats-mismatch: Beats add up to {sum}, but the meter has {beats}
warnings.landmark-too-long: This lyric landmark has {words} words; keep it to {max} or fewer
warnings.unsupported-version: This chart says ChartDown {version}; this parser reads {supported}
warnings.header-not-closed: The header needs a closing --- line
warnings.use-with-rows: @use must be the only content line of a section; its own rows are kept
warnings.layer-no-section: Notes need a section first, like ## Chorus
warnings.layer-line: A layer holds only sections, bar headings and notes

errors.passwords_differ: The two passwords are not the same.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.intro: ChartDown is invite-only during the beta. Leave your email and we’ll write to you when there’s a place for you.
waitlist.sent: Thanks. We’ll write to you when there’s a place for you.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.name: Name
profile.instrumentsHint: Choose any; you can change them whenever you like.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.explain: This deletes your account, your profile, your personal space and your private versions, for good. Your public versions stay with the community, credited to “ChartDown”. In bands you lead, the longest-standing member takes over as music director.
delete.mismatch: That email does not match your account.

version.forkHint: Sign in to make your own copy of this version.
version.forkCc0: Your copy is public and shared under CC0, like every public version.
version.forkFailed: This version could not be forked. Try again.

newVersion.title: New version

search.label: Find the song by title
search.none: No songs match. Create it as a new song.

newVersion.author: Arrangement by
newVersion.sourceHint: Which recording this chart follows. Required.
newVersion.cc0: Public versions are shared under CC0: anyone may use them, and they stay with the community even if you delete your account.

errors.source_required: Choose a source: studio recording, live, acoustic or own arrangement.
errors.title_required: Write the song title (up to 200 characters).
errors.author_required: Write who made the arrangement (up to 80 characters).
errors.year_invalid: The year must be a whole number between 1800 and 2200.
errors.youtube_invalid: The link must be a YouTube address starting with https://.
errors.unknown: The version could not be published. Try again.

history.title: History
history.restored: Revision {number} was restored. It is now revision {as}, the current one.
history.restoreError: This revision could not be restored. Try again.

makePrivate.title: Make this version private
makePrivate.copy: You get a private copy with the current chart, and you keep editing it there.
makePrivate.frozen: This public version stays in the catalog under the name {author}, marked “Frozen public version”. Nobody can edit it anymore, you included.
makePrivate.others: Other people's sets and forks keep using the public version. Public versions are shared under CC0 and stay with the community.
makePrivate.cancel: Cancel and go back to the version
makePrivate.error: This version could not be made private. Try again.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.search: Search by title, artist or album
catalog.error: The catalog could not be loaded. Try again.

editor.changed: This version changed since you opened it, in another tab or device. Your text is still here: copy it, reload the page and save again.
editor.error: The chart could not be saved. Try again.

errors.bar_invalid: The bar must be a whole number from 1.
